description: Expedited appeals for when the person or their doctor says waiting could seriously harm their health: how fast the plan has to decide (72 hours for employer, Marketplace, Medicare Advantage and Medicaid plans), the filing deadline, the expedited external review that can run at the same time, and the rule text verbatim. Example questions: I need surgery next week and it was denied; can I get a faster insurance appeal; how long does an urgent appeal take.

letter_date.description: Date printed on the letter, if the reader missed it

received_date.description: Day the person actually received the letter, if they say

stage.description: pre_service = prior authorization, post_service = a claim for care already given, concurrent = ongoing care being cut

name: urgent_insurance_appeal
title: Urgent (expedited) appeal
